limits: Default then PASSIVE were each scheduled for 600 seconds; failed or partial runs retain their actual processing counts. There is no post-candidate long baseline.
Existing protocol passed is preserved separately; baseline lag-growth failure is included in overall acceptance.
A failed baseline does not provide a valid 600-second performance, final-transcript or exact CPU-savings comparison.
Any historical transcript reference is independent of current performance and CPU comparisons.
CPU totals cover the isolated service cgroup and descendants, excluding model load, warmup, clients and monitors.
CPU interval offsets use profile before.monotonic; exact audio capture start is not recorded.
Unobserved CPU prefixes and suffixes are not claimed as sampled. Intervals crossing the benchmark window are excluded from trend summaries.
CPU blocks combine two observed intervals using actual elapsed seconds; they are not audio capture minutes.
CPU trends are descriptive because no prior numerical CPU-stability acceptance threshold exists.
Lag recomputation uses rounded serialized samples; original reported lag percentiles and growth determine acceptance.
Whole-card GPU activity includes unrelated processes and is not theoretical compute occupancy.
Process memory peak sums are not simultaneous and are not feature-tensor allocation sizes.
Transcript hash equality covers only these two controlled looping samples.
Loopback PC/mobile protocol tests do not replace Android, remote-network or desktop-paste validation.
